role.zh: 對應職能：資料分析師／資料科學家

tagline.zh: 把商業問題變成可驗證的假設，用嚴謹的統計給出可行動的答案。
tagline.en: Turn business questions into testable hypotheses, then answer them with rigorous, actionable statistics.

intro.zh: 分析的價值不在模型多複雜，而在於回答對的問題，並讓決策者信得過結果。我在台大專攻應用計量與因果推論，實務上用 SQL 與 Python 篩選變數、以統計檢定與實驗設計驗證假設，再把結果轉成具體建議。以下七張卡片是我反覆使用的工作方法。
intro.en: Analytics pays off only when it answers the right question in a way decision-makers can trust. At NTU I focus on applied econometrics and causal inference; in practice I screen drivers with SQL and Python, validate hypotheses with statistical tests and experiment design, and translate the results into concrete recommendations. These seven cards are the playbooks I return to again and again.

zh: 決策先於資料
每個分析都要對應一個「結果不同，做法就會不同」的決策。
en: Decision before data
Every analysis should serve a decision that would change depending on the result.

zh: 相關不等於因果
能隨機就隨機；不能隨機，就把識別假設講清楚並檢驗。
en: Correlation is not causation
Randomize when you can; when you can't, state the identifying assumptions and test them.

zh: 誠實面對不確定性
報告效果量與信賴區間，而不是只看 p 值是否顯著。
en: Be honest about uncertainty
Report effect sizes and confidence intervals, not just whether p < 0.05.

oneLiner.zh: 問題定義 → 資料與品質 → 建模與分析 → 部署與價值，每段都有明確交付與關卡。
oneLiner.en: Frame → data & quality → modeling & analysis → deploy & value, each stage with a clear deliverable and a gate.

zh: 商業需求模糊，需要轉成可分析的問題
專案跨部門，要對齊範圍、交付與時程
回顧過去的分析為何沒被採用
en: A vague business request needs to become an analyzable question
The project spans teams and needs aligned scope, deliverables and timing
Diagnosing why a past analysis never got used

zh: 定義：寫下要支援的決策、成功指標，以及什麼結果會改變決策
資料：確認分析單位與時間窗，檢查缺值、重複、異常與定義一致性
建模：先做描述統計與基準線，再選真正能回答問題的方法
部署：把結論轉成行動、負責人與追蹤指標，並監控成效衰退
en: Frame: write down the decision, the success metric and what result would change the decision
Data: fix the unit of analysis and time window; check missing values, duplicates, outliers and definition consistency
Model: start with descriptives and a baseline, then pick the method that actually answers the question
Deploy: turn findings into actions, owners and tracking metrics; monitor for performance decay

example.zh: 在合庫人壽的專案，先用議題樹界定營收曝險與數位機會（定義），以 SQL 篩選 40 多個客戶屬性（資料），用 XGBoost 排序回應驅動因子（建模），最後把結果轉成分階段的數位路線圖（部署）。
example.en: At Cardif, an issue tree framed the revenue exposure and digital opportunity (frame); I screened 40+ customer attributes in SQL (data) and ranked response drivers with XGBoost (model), and the work landed as a phased digital roadmap (deploy).

zh: 跳過定義直接建模，最後答非所問
清理規則沒有記錄，結果無法重現
把報告當終點，沒人負責後續追蹤
en: Jumping into modeling before framing, then answering the wrong question
Undocumented cleaning rules that make results irreproducible
Treating the report as the finish line, with no owner for follow-through

name.zh: 指標拆解與北極星指標

oneLiner.zh: 把目標拆成可行動的驅動因子，並用護欄指標防止顧此失彼。
oneLiner.en: Break the goal into actionable drivers, and use guardrail metrics so a gain in one place isn't a loss elsewhere.

zh: 診斷營收或成長變動的來源
為 dashboard 或實驗選主要與護欄指標
各部門對同一指標的定義不一致
en: Diagnosing where a revenue or growth change comes from
Choosing primary and guardrail metrics for a dashboard or experiment
Teams define the same metric differently

zh: 選一個反映顧客價值、團隊可影響的北極星指標
用乘法或加法拆解，例如營收＝顧客數×頻率×客單價
逐一定義分子、分母與時間窗；比率指標以 delta method 估變異
為每個槓桿指定負責人，並配一個不可惡化的護欄指標
合成分數先轉百分位等級再加權，避免尺度與極端值主導
en: Pick one north-star metric that reflects customer value and that the team can move
Decompose multiplicatively or additively, e.g. revenue = customers × frequency × ticket size
Define numerator, denominator and time window for every node; use the delta method for ratio-metric variance
Give each lever an owner and pair it with a guardrail that must not worsen
For composite scores, convert inputs to percentile ranks before weighting so scale and outliers don't dominate

example.zh:
信用卡專案把總簽帳金額拆成「平均每筆金額 × 交易筆數」，聚焦平均金額槓桿與百貨消費情境。
撈王專案要求多項指標同時成立，例如實驗組對照組的 60 天回訪率，加上晚餐來客不被侵蝕的護欄，才算真正的新需求。
本站的模型雷達則把 5 個因子轉成百分位等級後加權計分。
example.en:
The credit card project split total spend into average spend per transaction × number of transactions, then focused on the average-spend lever and the department-store occasion.
For Laowang, several indicators had to hold at once, e.g. the 60-day repeat rate of treatment vs control plus a guardrail on cannibalized dinner traffic, before counting demand as genuinely new.
This site's model radar converts 5 factors to percentile ranks before weighting them into one score.

template.zh:
指標名稱：＿＿
定義：分子＿＿／分母＿＿／時間窗＿＿／排除＿＿
資料來源與更新頻率：＿＿
負責人：＿＿
護欄指標：＿＿（不得低於＿＿）
template.en:
Metric: ___
Definition: numerator ___ / denominator ___ / window ___ / exclusions ___
Source & refresh: ___
Owner: ___
Guardrail: ___ (must not fall below ___)

zh: 選虛榮指標（下載、曝光），與價值脫鉤
只看比率，忽略分母組成改變（辛普森悖論）
指標太多，沒有一個真正對決策負責
en: Vanity metrics (downloads, impressions) disconnected from value
Reading ratios while ignoring shifts in the denominator mix (Simpson's paradox)
So many metrics that none is accountable for a decision

name.zh: 顧客分群：從 RFM 到分群模型
name.en: Customer Segmentation: From RFM to Clustering

oneLiner.zh: 好分群不是統計上最漂亮，而是每群對應不同行動，且隨時間穩定。
oneLiner.en: A good segmentation isn't the statistically prettiest: each segment gets a different action and stays stable over time.

zh: 會員經營或 CRM 需要差異化溝通
預算有限，要決定先投資哪些客群
想從交易資料找出未知的行為型態
en: Membership or CRM programs need differentiated treatment
Budget is limited and you must choose which customers to invest in first
You want to uncover unknown behavior patterns in transaction data

zh: 先用規則式 RFM 建立可解釋的基準分群
需要更多維度時，對數轉換並標準化後跑 k-means 或 GMM
以輪廓係數、BIC 與商業可解釋性共同決定群數
合併行動相同的群，替每群命名並寫下對應策略
換期間或 bootstrap 重跑，檢查穩定度與群間移動
en: Start with rule-based RFM for an interpretable baseline
When you need more dimensions, log-transform and standardize, then run k-means or a GMM
Choose the number of segments by silhouette, BIC and business interpretability together
Merge cells that get the same action; name each segment and write its play
Re-run on another period or bootstrap samples to check stability and migration

example.zh:
撈王專案將 R、F、M 各分高低，得到 2×2×2＝8 格，再依行動合併成 5 個生命週期層級：嘗鮮客、成長客、常客／VIP、降溫客、沉睡客。
以最近一次消費（R）為主要觸發條件，因為久未回訪的顧客無論過去花多少都不易回流；「降溫客」近期流失但歷史價值高，最值得挽回。
example.en:
For Laowang Hot Pot, splitting R, F and M into high/low gave 2×2×2 = 8 cells, consolidated by action into 5 lifecycle tiers: trial, developing, regular/VIP, cooling and dormant.
Recency was the primary trigger because a lapsed guest is unlikely to return whatever they spent before; the cooling tier, recently lapsed but historically valuable, was the most worth saving.

zh: 未處理偏態與尺度就跑 k-means，被金額主導
群分得越來越細，行動卻無法區分
用所得等人口屬性代替行為，與實際消費脫節
en: Running k-means on skewed, unscaled features so monetary value dominates
Splitting into ever-finer segments that don't get different actions
Using demographics like income as a proxy for behavior, though it may barely track spend

oneLiner.zh: 上線前定好 MDE、檢定力與樣本數；上線後先查 SRM 再看結果，不偷看。
oneLiner.en: Fix MDE, power and sample size before launch; after launch, check SRM before reading results, and don't peek.

zh: 評估新功能、推播或優惠的增量效果
能隨機分派使用者、門市或時段
是否擴大推行取決於實驗結果
en: Measuring the incremental effect of a feature, push message or offer
You can randomize users, stores or time slots
A scale-up decision depends on the result

zh: 事先登記假設、主要與護欄指標、分析單位及停止規則
由基準值、MDE、α 與檢定力算出樣本數與所需天數
用實驗前資料做 CUPED，降低變異、縮短實驗時間
讀結果前先以卡方檢定查 SRM，確認分流比例正確
需中途檢視就用序貫檢定；報告效果量與信賴區間
en: Pre-register the hypothesis, primary and guardrail metrics, unit of analysis and stopping rule
Derive sample size and runtime from the baseline, MDE, α and power
Apply CUPED with pre-period data to cut variance and shorten the test
Before reading results, run a chi-square SRM check to confirm the traffic split
If you must look early, use a sequential test; report effect size with a confidence interval

example.zh:
例如：基準轉換率 5%，想偵測提升 0.5 個百分點，在 α＝0.05（雙尾）、檢定力 80% 下，每組約需 3.1 萬人。
撈王專案的嘗鮮客 CRM 也規劃以實驗組與對照組比較 60 天回訪率，驗證個人化推播能否帶來第二次到店。
example.en:
Example: with a 5% baseline conversion and a 0.5-point MDE, α = 0.05 (two-sided) and 80% power need roughly 31,000 users per arm.
For Laowang, the trial-guest CRM was designed with treatment and control groups, comparing 60-day repeat rates to verify whether personalized pushes drive a second visit.

template.zh:
假設：若＿＿，則＿＿會提升，因為＿＿
隨機單位／分析單位：＿＿／＿＿
主要指標：＿＿；護欄指標：＿＿
基準值＿＿、MDE＿＿、α＿＿、檢定力＿＿ → 每組＿＿人、＿＿天
決策規則：顯著且護欄未惡化則擴大，否則＿＿
template.en:
Hypothesis: if ___, then ___ will rise, because ___
Randomization / analysis unit: ___ / ___
Primary metric: ___; guardrails: ___
Baseline ___, MDE ___, α ___, power ___ → ___ per arm, ___ days
Decision rule: scale if significant and guardrails hold; otherwise ___

zh: 天天看 p 值、一顯著就停，偽陽性大增
以門市分流卻以顧客算變異，低估標準誤
同時檢定多個指標卻未做多重比較校正
en: Checking p-values daily and stopping at the first significant result, inflating false positives
Randomizing by store but computing variance per customer, understating standard errors
Testing many metrics without a multiple-comparison correction

name.en: Causal Inference: Choosing the Right Design

oneLiner.zh: 能隨機就隨機；不能時依資料結構選方法，並把識別假設攤開檢驗。
oneLiner.en: Randomize if you can; if not, let the data structure choose the design, and test its identifying assumptions in the open.

zh: 政策或活動已上線，無法事後隨機
隨機分派不可行、不合倫理或成本過高
要回答「如果沒做會怎樣」的反事實問題
en: A policy or campaign has already launched and can't be randomized after the fact
Randomization is infeasible, unethical or too costly
You need the counterfactual: what would have happened otherwise?

zh: 有前後期與對照組 → DiD，用事件研究圖檢查平行趨勢
依門檻分派 → RDD，檢查斷點處連續、無人為操弄
有外生誘因 → IV，驗證相關性並論證排除限制
單一處理單位 → 合成控制；觀察資料 → 配對或 DML（需無未觀察干擾）
以安慰劑與敏感度分析測試結論是否穩健
en: Pre/post data with a comparison group → DiD; check parallel trends with an event-study plot
Assignment by a cutoff → RDD; check continuity at the cutoff and no manipulation
An exogenous nudge → IV; show relevance and argue the exclusion restriction
One treated unit → synthetic control; observational data → matching or DML (requires no unobserved confounding)
Stress-test conclusions with placebo and sensitivity analyses

example.zh:
例如：某銀行只在北部分行推出新 App 功能。以南部分行為對照、比較導入前後活躍率的變化就是 DiD，但要先確認兩區在導入前走勢平行。
若功能改為只開放給信用分數高於門檻的客戶，就能用 RDD 比較門檻兩側的客戶。
example.en:
Example: a bank rolls out a new app feature only in its northern branches. Comparing the before/after change in active rate against southern branches is a DiD, provided the two regions trended in parallel before launch.
If the feature were instead gated by a credit-score cutoff, an RDD comparing customers just above and below the cutoff would be cleaner.

zh: 只加控制變數就宣稱因果，忽略未觀察干擾
分批導入仍用傳統雙向固定效果 DiD，估計偏誤
弱工具變數，或工具本身直接影響結果
en: Adding controls and calling it causal while ignoring unobserved confounders
Using classic two-way fixed-effects DiD under staggered adoption, which can bias estimates
Weak instruments, or instruments that affect the outcome directly

name.zh: 建模與驗證：先有基準線

oneLiner.zh: 複雜模型必須贏過簡單基準線，驗證方式也要模擬真實上線情境。
oneLiner.en: A complex model must beat a simple baseline, and validation must mimic how the model will really be used.

zh: 預測流失、回應、違約等二元結果
從大量候選變數中找出關鍵驅動因子
模型分數要用來排序名單或設定門檻
en: Predicting churn, response, default or other binary outcomes
Finding key drivers among many candidate features
Scores will rank a target list or feed a decision threshold

zh: 先建基準線：簡單規則或邏輯斯迴歸
切分貼近現實：時間資料用時間切分，同一顧客不跨訓練與測試集
逐一確認每個特徵在預測時點已可取得，杜絕資料洩漏
再上 XGBoost 等模型，以 AUC、PR-AUC 與校準曲線評估
用 SHAP 或排列重要度解釋，並與業務邏輯交叉檢查
en: Build a baseline first: a simple rule or logistic regression
Split like reality: time-based splits for temporal data; never let one customer span train and test
Confirm every feature is available at prediction time to rule out leakage
Then try models like XGBoost; evaluate with AUC, PR-AUC and calibration curves
Explain with SHAP or permutation importance and sanity-check against business logic

example.zh:
在合庫人壽，我先以 SQL 篩選 40 多個客戶屬性，再用 XGBoost 排序回應驅動因子，聚焦前 5 名。
通用原則：若 XGBoost 的 AUC 只比邏輯斯迴歸高一點點，通常選較易解釋與維護的後者。
example.en:
At Cardif I screened 40+ customer attributes in SQL, then ranked response drivers with XGBoost to isolate the top 5.
Rule of thumb: if XGBoost beats logistic regression by only a sliver of AUC, the simpler, more explainable model usually wins.

template.zh:
預測目標與用途：預測＿＿，用於＿＿
基準線與成績：＿＿
切分方式：時間／群組＿＿
洩漏檢查：每個特徵在＿＿時點可取得
評估：AUC＿＿、PR-AUC＿＿、校準＿＿
前 5 大驅動因子：＿＿，是否合乎業務直覺？
template.en:
Target & use: predict ___ to support ___
Baseline & score: ___
Split: time / group ___
Leakage check: every feature available at ___
Evaluation: AUC ___, PR-AUC ___, calibration ___
Top 5 drivers: ___; do they make business sense?

zh: 時間資料用隨機切分，成績虛高
先在全資料上做特徵選擇或標準化才切分
類別不平衡時只看準確率
en: Random splits on temporal data, producing inflated scores
Running feature selection or scaling on the full dataset before splitting
Judging an imbalanced problem by accuracy alone

oneLiner.zh: 從發現走到決策：結論先行、一張圖一個洞察，並講清楚所以要做什麼。
oneLiner.en: Move from finding to decision: lead with the answer, one insight per chart, and spell out the so-what.

zh: 向主管或客戶報告分析結果
設計 dashboard 或定期報表
結果違反直覺，需要說服利害關係人
en: Presenting results to executives or clients
Designing a dashboard or recurring report
Results run against intuition and stakeholders need convincing

zh: 先用一句話寫出結論與建議，再挑支持它的圖
依問題選圖：趨勢用折線、比較用長條、關係用散布圖
標題直接寫洞察，只用顏色標出重點
並列效果量與信賴區間，交代限制與下一步
en: Write the conclusion and recommendation in one sentence, then pick the charts that support it
Choose charts by question: lines for trends, bars for comparisons, scatter for relationships
Make the title the insight; use color only to highlight the point
Show effect sizes with confidence intervals; state limitations and next steps

example.zh:
信用卡專案的問卷（n＝291）以單尾單一樣本 t 檢定對照中立值 3，三個假設皆顯著，其中分級回饋支持度最高；所得與簽帳金額僅弱相關（r ≈ 0.22）。
可行動的結論因此很清楚：以消費行為而非所得定義目標客群，並把分級回饋設計進推廣方案。
example.en:
In the credit card project, one-tailed one-sample t-tests against the neutral midpoint of 3 (n = 291) supported all three hypotheses, with tiered rewards scoring highest; income correlated only weakly with card spend (r ≈ 0.22).
The actionable takeaway was clear: define the target segment by spending behavior, not income, and build tiered rewards into the go-to-market plan.

template.zh:
標題（洞察）：＿＿使＿＿變化＿＿
證據：圖＿＿；效果量＿＿（95% 信賴區間＿＿）
所以呢：建議＿＿，預期影響＿＿
限制與下一步：＿＿
template.en:
Title (the insight): ___ moves ___ by ___
Evidence: chart ___; effect size ___ (95% CI ___)
So what: recommend ___, expected impact ___
Limits & next steps: ___

zh: 照分析順序報告，把結論藏在最後
雙軸、3D 圓餅或截斷座標軸誤導讀者
只報 p 值，不說效果多大、對業務代表什麼
en: Narrating the analysis chronologically and burying the conclusion
Dual axes, 3D pies or truncated axes that mislead
Reporting p-values without effect size or business meaning
